summary: All pages remain visually intact with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. Performance is recovering — /about and /projects climbed back above 85, and both project detail pages improved materially — but the homepage (80) and both detail pages (76) still sit below the 85 threshold, and LCPs remain elevated above 3–4 s site-wide.

top_fix: LCP remains above 3.9 s on the homepage and above 4.5 s on both project detail pages, keeping their performance scores below 85: preload the hero/LCP image on each page with `<link rel="preload" fetchpriority="high">`, serve all images as WebP at display dimensions, and code-split or defer non-critical JS — this is the single change most likely to push all pages above 85.
